mapper.sql: select id, user_id, video_id from collects
mapper.select:
select c.id,c.user_id,c.video_id,v.title,v.cover,u.name as user_name from collects c inner join videos v on c.video_id = v.id inner join users u on v.user_id = u.id where c.user_id = #{userId}
and v.title like concat('%',#{keyword},'%')
